name: Create a private room and complete a synchronized match
description: Verifies the core multiplayer game remains playable after the competition hub is added.
steps: Actor A creates a private room
Actor B joins using the six-character code
Players roll and make legal moves
expected: Both players see the same room and synchronized game state.

name: Create and join a free tournament
description: Checks that players can create a tournament, join it and let the host start its bracket.
steps: Actor A opens Competition Centre and creates a 4-player tournament
Actor B opens the same tournament list and joins
expected: The tournament changes from open to live and displays generated fixtures without requiring external integrations.

name: View rankings and personal match history
description: Verifies completed games feed the rankings and the current player's match summary.
steps: Complete a match with two human players
Open Competition Centre and select Rankings
expected: The completed match contributes to the relevant players' totals and appears in the participant's recent history.

name: Watch a room without joining or controlling it
description: Checks that a viewer can follow a match through a public read-only room projection.
steps: Actor A and Actor B start a match
Actor C opens Watch match and enters the room code
Observe the public player list and current turn
Actor A makes a move and Actor C observes the refreshed state
expected: Actor C sees public match information and has no player seat or game controls.

name: Expose a consent-first integration manifest
covers: private chat and media stream exclusion
description: Verifies the integration foundation advertises only approved future summary scopes and excludes private communications and live media.
steps: Open Competition Centre and select Connect
Review the API version and future plugin list
Review the allowed scopes and never-exposed data list
expected: The app reports zero connected apps, requires consent for future sharing, and excludes private messages, camera, microphone, contacts and credentials.
